title: Finite-field pro-étale ordinary direct-image finiteness
statement: Let $\ell$ be a prime, $k$ a field of characteristic $p>0$ with $p\ne\ell$, and $A$ a finite field of characteristic $\ell$. Let $f:T\to V$ be a finite-type $k$-morphism between finite-type $k$-schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Use ordinary uncompleted derived categories of module sheaves over the constant ring sheaf $A_T$ on small pro-étale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Write $\mathcal B_A(T)$ for the complexes whose cohomology vanishes outside a finite interval and is constructible [def-weil-proetale-constructible-sheaf]: there is a finite constructible locally closed stratification on which each cohomology sheaf is pro-étale locally constant with finite-dimensional $A$-module values. Then the ordinary total right derived functor $Rf_*$ [def-sfb-right-derived-functor] of the module direct image $f_*$ [def-weil-proetale-module-direct-image], computed by applying $f_*$ to a K-injective resolution, satisfies $Rf_*\mathcal B_A(T)\subseteq\mathcal B_A(V)$. No finiteness, perfection or separable closedness of $k$ is assumed.

proof.text: A field is Noetherian and its spectrum is quasi-compact. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-over-noetherian] to the structure morphisms: $T,V$ are Noetherian, hence quasi-compact. By [lem-weil-pbc-locally-noetherian-quasi-separated] they are quasi-separated. Then [lem-weil-pbc-qcqs-morphism-permanence] (1) makes $f$ qcqs; no separatedness is needed.

source.place: Tag 01OY (lemma-locally-Noetherian-quasi-separated); finite-type permanence and qcqs morphism permanence as in the cited nodes

proof.text: Over the finite field $A$, finitely generated, finitely presented and finite-dimensional modules coincide and are finite sets. Apply [lem-sfb-noetherian-global-constructibility] on both sites of $T,V$: the affine-local constructibility condition and the global finite-stratification condition defining $\mathcal B_A$ agree.

source.place: Tags 09AJ (definition-constructible), 09AK (lemma-compare-constructible), 09AL (lemma-compare-constructible-derived); global stratification gluing as in the cited node

proof.text: For $K\in\mathcal B_A(T)$, [sk-thm-pe-constructible-comparison] gives $G\in D^b_c(T_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ and $\alpha:\nu_T^*G\xrightarrow{\sim}K$. Step 2 matches its constructibility convention. The comparison inverse image $\nu_T^*$ used here is canonically isomorphic to the intrinsic constant-section inverse image by the adjoint-uniqueness clause of [lem-sfb-ordinary-proetale-direct-image-plus-comparison] (with $B=A$, $X=T$); hence by [lem-pe-coefficient-comparison-derived-functor] it is the ordinary termwise inverse image followed by localization and it commutes with cohomology.

source.place: Tags 09AK and 09AL; the actual module derived inverse image as in the cited coefficient-comparison node

proof.text: The finite ring $A$ is killed by $\ell$, and $\ell$ is invertible in $k$ since $p\ne\ell$. Thus [thm-dg-finite-type-constructibility] applies to $f,G$ and gives $H:=Rf_{\mathrm{et},*}G\in D^b_c(V_{\mathrm{et}},A)$. Its statement allows arbitrary $k$ and non-separated $f$.

source.place: statement (ordinary étale finite-type direct-image finiteness, without separatedness); finite-field input in Bhatt–Scholze Theorem 6.7.1

proof.text:
Apply [lem-sfb-ordinary-proetale-direct-image-plus-comparison] with $B=A$: it supplies the full ordinary K-injective direct images, identifies both comparison inverse images, and gives $
u_V^*H\cong Rf_{\mathrm{proet},*}
u_T^*G$. Composing with $Rf_*(\alpha)$ identifies this with $Rf_*K$. By [lem-pe-coefficient-comparison-derived-functor], $\mathcal H^q(
u_V^*H)\cong
u_V^*\mathcal H^q(H)$, so the finite vanishing interval of $H$ is preserved. By [sk-thm-pe-constructible-comparison] these sheaves are constructible; step 2 gives the global convention. Hence $Rf_*K\in\mathcal B_A(V)$.
